title: The guard's matcher names every tool the guard handles, MCP GitHub tools included
why: Lane review-record-from-render found that no mcp__github__* tool is in the guard's PreToolUse matcher, so the guard code for MCP merges and draft PRs never ran (coordinator, 17:15 CST Nov 7). A merge through the MCP tool skips the merge guard.
note: Done check: a check that fails when a guard handles a tool name the matcher misses, red on main. Sighting (#2284 review, coordinator 14:51 CST Nov 8): mcp__github__merge_pull_request is also missing from the guard matcher, so no merge check runs for the MCP merge tool. This step owns it; the lane confirms its stack (#1601-#1694) adds that tool name, or adds it.
